summary: Hard-mode plan written: 8 dispatch phases (14 green-commit substeps) covering Branch.internalize plus its root anchor, the positive-context monotonicity engine, the forest invariant, the corrected rule_admissible harness, and all 21 routine admissibility lemmas across four new task-owned files. Every phase carries a Verification Tier, a Scope Hypothesis, a named build gate, and a territory declaration. The Barcan step (the task's one Medium-likelihood risk) is deliberately front-loaded into Wave 1 so it surfaces before 17 downstream lemmas depend on it; its exhaustion protocol is a named boundary hand-off, never a sorry. No strategic sorries are planned.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase hard-mode implementation plan: Internalize.lean definitions and root anchor, TemporalAssets.lean (fConjG/pConjH, diamondToFutureDiamond, barcanDiamondG), monotonicity engine, forest invariant plus rule_admissible harness, and the 21 lemmas across Rules/{Propositional,Modal,Temporal}.lean. Passes validate-artifact.sh --strict.

Hard-mode research input (Tier 3, H4-verified): 34-rule verified inventory, the 21/13/2 territory split, time-major flat-diamond internalization design, five corrections to the rule_admissible shape, and the verified Barcan route.

decisions_made: Time-major skeleton with a flat diamond per non-root world at each time node; the task charter's 'world labels via box/diamond nesting' text is corrected by research section 3.3 and is NOT implemented.

The U/S guard slot is taken in per-edge function form (guard : TimeIndex -> TimeIndex -> Formula) instantiated at fun _ _ => Formula.top, per risk R2, because 411's needs are not yet known and retrofitting the arity later would force 411 to reprove this task's tree-touching lemmas.
The rule_admissible harness lives in Verified/Internalize.lean, not Verified/Refutation/Core.lean, which belongs to 412 -- placing it there would be a territory collision.

Object-language assets (fConjG, pConjH, diamondToFutureDiamond, barcanDiamondG) go in a task-owned Verified/Refutation/Rules/TemporalAssets.lean rather than into FormalSystem/Theorems/; in particular the inline future_comp step in Perpetuity/Principles.lean is re-proved locally rather than hoisted, because Theorems/ is read-only for this task.
The Barcan phase is front-loaded into Wave 1 rather than placed last as the research report's tier ordering suggests, so its Medium-likelihood risk surfaces before 17 downstream lemmas depend on it.

applyRule_preserves_forest is narrowed from research section 3.5's all-21 form to generic addFuture/addPast preservation lemmas in Phase 4.1 plus four one-line instances in Phase 8, because only four of the 21 rules mutate the TimeOrdering at all (boxNeg/diamondPos mint a fresh world, not a fresh time). This keeps both phases inside the H8 bounded-unit test.

Sub-phases are nested at #### rather than ###, so the phase-accounting regex matches exactly 8 dispatch units; promoting them would double-count every grouped phase and distort the progress denominator.

No strategic sorries are planned (plan_metadata.skeleton = false). The R1 contingency for an exhausted Barcan derivation is a named boundary hand-off to 411 of the cross-world gProps/fNegProps sub-case of rules 15/17/18/20, with Phase 8 marked BLOCKED and Phases 3-7 completed in full -- explicitly not a sorry and explicitly not a silently reduced emission set.
dead_ends: World-major internalization (one diamond per world containing that world's whole time tree): rejected, makes boxPos unprovable because it needs the false F(box psi) -> box psi. Do not revisit.

Report 02's rule_admissible shape (forall children in applyRule r sf b ord, ...): does not typecheck -- applyRule returns RuleResult x TimeOrdering and RuleResult has five constructors. Use the corrected shape in research section 4.
A general Formula context type for the monotonicity engine: dropped by the research report's own recommendation 1 after seeing that only four formers occur. Recurse over timeTree's structure instead.
Anything scoped against buildTableau_isSome: that theorem is false; a budget-parameterised replacement is another task's.
The retired PASSIVE arms of untlNeg/snceNeg, and sat_untl_neg / sat_snce_neg: deleted from the tree. Neither rule is in this task's scope at all.

hard_mode.phase_sizing_h8: 8 dispatch phases at 200-450 lines of output each, inside the 100-500 budget; 14 nested green-commit substeps. Every phase names one verifiable unit with a concrete stopping condition -- Phase 2.3 (the Barcan derivation) states a two-route attempt budget rather than relying on its line estimate, because it is the one open-ended proof in the task.
boundary_notes: serialityRule and timeLinearity (rules 35-36) are 430's; both are provably outside allRulesForFC (RuleSpec.lean:337,342). No phase writes admissibility for them, and the .branchingOrdered arm stays a vacuous True.

Rules 22-34 (13 lemmas) are 411's, in Rules/{UntilSince,Trichotomy,Discrete,Dense,Dedekind}.lean. priorUZ/priorSZ stay 411's despite report 02 rating them routine (research section 2.2, contradiction C1); they are 411's two cheapest, not hard ones.
Refutation/Core.lean and Verified/Provable.lean are 412's. If a phase finds it would need one of these, it records a boundary note and stops rather than absorbing it.
The residual forest obligation after this task is exactly densityRule (411) and timeLinearity (430), named in Phase 4.1's docstring so neither owner can lose it.
hard_mode.regression_gate: Baseline sorry count in the Decidability tree is 6 (Propositional/Decidable.lean 1, Correctness.lean 1, Verified/Termination/TimeTypeBound.lean 1, Verified/Bridge/IntTruth.lean 3). It must not increase. A new sorry in a pre-existing file is a regression, not a deferral.

build_gates.note: A new module is only compiled once reachable from FormalSystem.lean, so the append-only import line in FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability.lean is part of whichever phase creates the file.

literature.note: Tier 3 (implementation-backed). The Burgess/Reynolds axioms are already transcribed into ProofSystem/Axioms.lean with per-constructor provenance docstrings, so this task works against those transcriptions and no paper is newly transcribed. No literature work was manufactured.
